description: This file contains helper functions for Kubernetes scheduler plugins, specifically for determining service selectors and related label-based matching logic.

methods.name: DefaultSelector
methods.description: Determines a label selector for a pod based on its associated services and owner controllers (ReplicationController, ReplicaSet, StatefulSet).

methods.name: GetPodServices
methods.description: Retrieves services that match the labels on a given pod.

search-terms: replication controller, replica set, stateful set
